response.original_title: We Are the World: A 10th Anniversary Tribute
response.overview: We Are the World: A 10th Anniversary Tribute (also known as One Song, Many Hands: The USA for Africa Story) is a 1995 documentary special narrated by Harry Belafonte that chronicles the creation, recording, and humanitarian impact of the 1985 charity single "We Are the World." Directed by Foster Wiley, it aired on the Disney Channel starting in February 1995 to mark the song's tenth anniversary.
